card.border-disabled.$description: Border colour of a disabled card, in the muted border tone.

textarea.background-disabled.$description: Fill of the textarea when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable. Pairs with `textarea.text-disabled`.

textarea.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the textarea when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

select.trigger.background-disabled.$description: Fill of the select trigger when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable. Pairs with `select.trigger.text-disabled`.

select.trigger.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the select trigger when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3). Pairs with `select.trigger.background-disabled`.

select.trigger.border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the select trigger when disabled, in the muted border tone.

select.item.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the select item when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

checkbox.background-disabled.$description: Fill of the checkbox when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable. Pairs with `checkbox.text-disabled`.

checkbox.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the checkbox when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3). Pairs with `checkbox.background-disabled`.

checkbox.border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the checkbox when disabled, in the muted border tone.

radio.background-disabled.$description: Fill of the radio when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable.

radio.border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the radio when disabled, in the muted border tone.

radio.indicator-disabled.$description: Colour of the dot inside a disabled selected radio. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

switch.track.background-disabled.$description: Track fill when disabled, in either state. A quiet neutral, not a fade.

slider.thumb-background-disabled.$description: Fill of the slider thumb when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable.

slider.thumb-border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the slider thumb when disabled, in the muted border tone.

toggle.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the toggle when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

toggle.border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the toggle when disabled, in the muted border tone.

tabs.trigger.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the tabs trigger when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

pagination.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the pagination when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

navigation.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the navigation menu when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

dropdown-menu.item.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the dropdown menu item when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

contextmenu.item-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the context menu item when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

menubar.item-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the menubar item when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

command.item-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the command menu item when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

command.input-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the command menu input when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

carousel.nav-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the carousel nav when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3). Pairs with `carousel.nav-background-disabled`.

carousel.nav-border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the carousel nav when disabled, in the muted border tone.

carousel.nav-background-disabled.$description: Fill of the carousel nav when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable. Pairs with `carousel.nav-text-disabled`.

calendar.nav-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the calendar nav when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

calendar.nav-border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the calendar nav when disabled, in the muted border tone.

toast.action-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the toast action when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

toast.action-border-disabled.$description: Border colour of the toast action when disabled, in the muted border tone.

site-header.nav-link.text-disabled.$description: Text colour of the site header nav link when disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

form.label-text-disabled.$description: Text colour of a form label when its control is disabled. Faint, and exempt from contrast under WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3).

toggle.pressed-disabled.$description: Fill of a pressed (on) toggle when disabled, a quiet neutral so it reads as unavailable.
